subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: technical deep dive and rotating timezone cadence
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@finlytics.com>, Lara Schmidt <lara@finlytics.de>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: technical deep dive and rotating timezone cadence

Hi Tom / Lara — thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: FinLytics is focused on low-latency inference for report generation across US/EU/APAC offices, strict data residency needs for EU, and SSO + audit logging requirements.
- Goal for the next session: technical deep dive with infra/security and an abbreviated hands-on demo of our Dedicated offering (30–45 min tech + 15 min Q&A).

Scheduling ask: to be fair to distributed teams, we propose a rotating cadence so each region gets at least one friendly-hour slot over a 3-week cycle (APAC / EMEA / NA). That avoids repeatedly forcing the same team outside normal hours. Below are candidate windows (all three are ~60 minutes) — I've converted to the main office timezones: 

Option A (APAC-friendly):
- Tue Jul 20, 2026, 10:00 AEST / Mon Jul 19, 20:00 PDT / Mon Jul 19, 13:00 BST

Option B (EMEA-friendly):
- Tue Jul 27, 2026, 16:00 CEST / Tue Jul 27, 07:00 PDT / Wed Jul 28, 00:00 AEST

Option C (NA-friendly):
- Wed Aug 4, 2026, 11:00 PDT / Wed Aug 4, 19:00 CEST / Thu Aug 5, 02:00 AEST

If we land on a 3-week repeating rhythm, the pattern would be: APAC-friendly week -> EMEA-friendly week -> NA-friendly week. That keeps late/early burdens rotating.

Attachments: I attached a draft agenda (FinLytics-demo-agenda.pdf) and our security checklist so you can flag anything we should prep ahead.

Please reply with preferred option (A/B/C) and who from your side should join (security/infra emails). If none of these work, tell us 2 windows that do and well match. I can send calendar holds once we confirm.

Thanks — Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
evelyn@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for teams
From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@finlytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Schmidt <lara@finlytics.de>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 20:03:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: technical deep dive and rotating timezone cadence

Thanks Evelyn — great summary. Were keen to see the Dedicated flow and the SSO/audit logging capabilities. Quick notes: 

- Preference: Option A (APAC-friendly) is best for our SU/Infra team in Tokyo.
- Attendees from FinLytics: me (Tom), Lara (EMEA lead) and our infra lead Jiro Nakamura (jiro.nakamura@sumoanalytics.jp) — Jiro will want to review your security checklist before the call.
- If we do a rotating cadence, can we please make sure recordings + quick runbooks are available for the region that missed that week? That will help async reviewers.

I'll ask Jiro to confirm availability; otherwise Option A looks good.

Tom
Director of AI Ops, FinLytics
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: technical deep dive and rotating timezone cadence

Appreciate the quick reply, Tom — looping in Sergio who will run the demo portion and handle the KV/cache overview. A couple operational notes and one small ask: 

- We can confirm Option A (Tue Jul 20, 10:00 AEST) for an initial technical deep dive. Ill create a calendar hold for 60 minutes and include a short agenda.
- Rotation plan: propose this repeating 3-week pattern if FinLytics wants a standing "tri-zone" session: Week 1 APAC-friendly, Week 2 EMEA-friendly, Week 3 NA-friendly. Well attach recordings and a condensed runbook to each meeting notes doc.
- Security prep: Tom / Jiro, please review the attached security-ask-checklist.xlsx and flag any items you want included in the demo (SSO flow, KMS integration, audit log retention).

Action: I will send a calendar invite for Jul 20 (Option A) and a follow-up invite for the repeating pattern if we all agree. Sergio — can you take the demo lead? Sergio: suggested tech run briefly covers compilation/kernel selection, routing policies, and KV caching behavior under mixed-latency loads (15–20 min).

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jiro Nakamura <jiro.nakamura@sumoanalytics.jp>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Lara Schmidt <lara@finlytics.de>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:44:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps: technical deep dive and rotating timezone cadence

Hi all — Jiro here. Jul 20 Option A works for our infra team. Quick answers after reviewing the checklist: 

- SSO: we use SAML with internal IdP. Wed like a short walk-through of your SSO setup and KMS integration.
- Audit logs: need confirmation on retention periods and whether logs can be forwarded to our SIEM (Splunk).
- Wed appreciate if the first session includes a 10-minute bench/latency demo with a mixed-shard workload representative of our daily job runner.

I can join Jul 20 and will add a couple of infra engineers to the calendar invite once Monica sends it.

Regards,
Jiro
Senior SRE, SumoAnalytics (partnering on FinLytics infra)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@finlytics.com>, Jiro Nakamura <jiro.nakamura@sumoanalytics.jp>, Lara Schmidt <lara@finlytics.de>

Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:15:00 +0100
Subject: Confirmed: Technical deep dive (Tue Jul 20) + rotating tri-zone cadence

Thanks everyone — confirmed: initial deep dive scheduled for Tue Jul 20 at 10:00 AEST (60 minutes). Calendar invite and recording permissions have been sent: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/evelyn/trizone-deep-dive

Quick notes / next steps before the session: 
- Pre-reads: FinLytics-demo-agenda.pdf (attached) and security-ask-checklist.xlsx.
- Sergio will lead the demo and include a 10-min mixed-workload latency bench, a SSO/KMS overview, and a short walkthrough of routing policy fallbacks.
- Monica will capture notes and publish recording + runbook within 24 hours of the meeting.
- Evelyn will loop in our compliance engineer for any follow-ups on log forwarding requirements.

Thanks — looking forward to it. If anything changes for attendees, please update the invite.

Best,
Evelyn
--
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
